response:
I am deeply concerned by what you’ve shared, and it is very important that you get medical help right away. Please call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) or take your baby to the nearest emergency room immediately. A baby becoming quiet and floppy after being shaken is a medical emergency that requires professional attention.

If you are feeling overwhelmed and are worried about hurting your baby, please call the National Parent Helpline at 1-855-427-2736 or the Crisis Text Line by texting HOME to 741741. You can also reach out to a trusted friend or family member to come over and help you right now. Please seek help for your baby and for yourself immediately.
